capabilities: web-archiving | Saves web pages you submit as HTML, screenshot, PDF, text and media snapshots in a private, searchable collection.
url-snapshots | Keeps a point-in-time copy of each submitted URL that you can browse later from the web interface, even if the original page disappears.
description:
UnitySVC runs the official ArchiveBox image in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. ArchiveBox is a self-hosted web archive: you give it URLs (one at a time in the web interface, by paste, or through its REST API and command line), and it saves each page with a headless Chromium browser and other extractors, as HTML, a screenshot, a PDF, readable text, media and more. The collection is browsed, searched and tagged in the web interface. It is private: nothing is listed or can be submitted without signing in. Everything is kept in the instance's own SQLite database and files, stored in the `archivebox` folder of your home, so it survives stopping the instance and even removing it and enrolling again.

Enroll in the base channel and keep or replace the generated administrator password. Sign in at `https://<instance>/` with the administrator name and password, then use **Add** to submit URLs; the first capture of a page takes a few minutes while the browser starts. Capturing runs on one core and uses well over a gigabyte of memory at peak, so the channel runs on the `small` size. You can run one ArchiveBox instance at a time. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time, and the platform keeps the collection in your home while it is stopped. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream ArchiveBox documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Generated for this enrollment; keep it or enter your own. It is the administrator's password only when ArchiveBox first creates that account; if the account already exists (an earlier enrollment, or a later restart) this value is ignored and the existing password still applies. Change the password in ArchiveBox's own admin pages. Save it; it is also shown in the enrollment's instance details.
ADMIN_PASSWORD.title: Administrator password

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: The administrator's user name, created on the first start. It is created only if no user of that name exists: your data lives in your home, so on a later start or enrollment the existing users still apply.
